thread:
maria: Quick Q on the rerank endpoint contract — should we treat a provided item.score as an absolute probability or a raw relevance/logit? Also what do we do for tie-breaking?

devin: We agreed scores are raw relevance (higher = better). API will also return a normalized_score for convenience.

ashley: Backcompat note: if client omits scores we should accept items like [{id, text}] and run the model to score them. Keep both flows.

samir: Edge cases: what about NaN / +inf / -inf in provided scores? Spec should call this out. I vote 400 with an error message rather than silently clamping.

olivia: Tie-breaking behavior: deterministic stable sort by (score desc, id asc) unless client supplies a tiebreaker param. Options: "tiebreaker": "timestamp" or "random_seed": int.

maria: Agreed. For random_seed we should make the shuffle deterministic among equal-score groups using a seeded PRNG. If no tiebreaker, fallback to id lexical order. Also we should document float precision causing near-ties and offer a "score_tolerance" (default 1e-6).

devin: Add top_k param semantics: if top_k > number of items, just return all items (no error).

ashley: Response shape proposal: items: [ { id, rank, score, normalized_score, explain? } ] where explain is present only when explain=true. Also include "scoring_version" in response metadata.

spec-bot: NOTE: add header-based versioning: X-API-Version (default "1"). v2 will change normalized_score scale to 0-100 (breaking).

samir: Tests to add: deterministic ties, NaN handling returns 400, missing-scores path (compute scores), random_seed determinism.

maria: I'll update the OpenAPI YAML and add unit tests. Assign reviewers devin + ashley. I'll open a PR later today.

devin: Ping me on the PR. Also please add a minimal cURL + JSON example in the spec.

ashley: One nit: should rank be 0-indexed or 1-indexed? Which do we want?

maria: Let's make rank 1-indexed (1 = top). We'll call it out in the response docs.

olivia: Also document tie stable order for mixed id types: do lexical string compare across id string representation.

maria: Summary / action items: 1) Update OpenAPI: add score_tolerance, random_seed behavior, tiebreaker docs, normalized_score field, X-API-Version note. 2) Add tests for NaN/inf, ties, seed determinism, compute-scores path. 3) Add example cURL. 4) PR reviewers: @devin @ashley.

devin: ack

ashley: ack

maria: Opening ticket: infra-1256 in backlog, will link PR.

spec-bot: Reminder: update SDK docs for any client libraries after API change is merged.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
